// std.viz · a sampled 3D vector field with SVG arrowheads and tooltips.
import std.viz

fn main() -> Void {
    mut xs: List<Float> = []
    mut ys: List<Float> = []
    mut zs: List<Float> = []
    mut us: List<Float> = []
    mut vs: List<Float> = []
    mut ws: List<Float> = []
    for i in 0 until 5 {
        for j in 0 until 5 {
            x = (i as Float) - 2.0
            y = (j as Float) - 2.0
            xs.push(x)
            ys.push(y)
            zs.push(0.0)
            us.push(0.0 - y)
            vs.push(x)
            ws.push(0.35)
        }
    }
    scene = viz.scene3d("Rotational vector field")
        .describe("25 samples · v(x, y, z) = (-y, x, 0.35)")
        .labels("x", "y", "z")
        .view(-48.0, 28.0)
        .vector_field(array(xs), array(ys), array(zs), array(us), array(vs), array(ws), color: "#2563eb", scale: 0.28)
    print(scene.svg())
}
